Senior QA Engineer - Test Automation Architect at CloudFlow SaaS. 8 years shaping resilient systems in the SaaS space. My focus is on building automation frameworks that scale with complexity, reduce manual effort, and align with business goals.  

API testing is my foundation—architected scalable solutions that integrate with microservices, mentor teams on best practices, and ensure reliability across distributed systems. Test automation isn’t just about scripts; it’s about strategy. I design frameworks that evolve with product needs, reduce flaky tests, and empower teams to ship confidently.  

BDD/TDD has transformed how we approach quality. By embedding tests into development workflows, we’ve cut regression cycles by 40% and improved stakeholder alignment. Performance testing with JMeter and k6 ensures our systems handle scale, while Selenium/Playwright pipelines deliver end-to-end reliability.  

Python is my go-to for tooling and data-driven insights, from custom reporting to CI/CD integrations. Java remains a touchstone for legacy systems, but I thrive at the intersection of modern practices and pragmatic solutions.  

Driven by impact, not jargon. Let’s build systems that matter.
